Name: Additional Simple Abigail's Seasonal Outfits
Author: Dan8023
Description:
[line]

[b][size=3][color=#00ffff]This mod will add a new look to Abigail's character and portraits during [/color][color=#00ff00]summer[/color][color=#00ffff] and [/color][color=#e69138]fall[/color][/size][/b]
[line]

[b]The character designs remain true to Stardew Valley's original style. You can also use the config feature to turn off portraits or simple customizations that it can do.[/b]


[color=#38761d][b]Spring[/b][/color]: Game default
[b][color=#00ff00]Summer[/color][/b]: This mod (Auto)
[color=#ff7700][b]Fall[/b][/color]: This mod (Auto)
[color=#3c78d8][b]Winter[/b][/color]: Game default



*assets is NOT AI generated

[spoiler][color=#00ff00]Copyright free[/color]. Other than that, nothing. Just enjoy.[/spoiler]
